page.layout: One page: a central woodcut device (armorial cartouche with the inscription IOHANNES · NOLTIVS) in the middle of the page. Above it a Zurich library stamp, which is not transcribed. The faint reversed text above and below the device is show-through from the other side, not transcribed.
page.notes: The woodcut is a decorative cartouche with a central crest: a lion-like figure with a helmet and foliage scrolls, framed by an arched border with the inscription IOHANNES · NOLTIVS, and a small mark in the lower-left corner that is too small to read. Its inscription is transcribed as one line. The purple oval stamp reading STADTBIBLIOTHEK ZURICH is a library stamp and is excluded. The mirrored lines above the woodcut and the faint lines below it are show-through from the reverse and are excluded. No printed title text on this side is legible.
